structural_review.notes: Triangle mode, valid GLB length, UVs and embedded 1024px base colour checked. Requested targets are approximate; actual triangle count and target deviations are reported separately, within the user-specified 3000-prop / 8000-character ceilings. Scale, pivot, topology and visual quality require separate review.

visual_review.notes: Accepted independent compact carbine: one open barrel/muzzle verified in front view, square magazine, wooden stock and pistol grip, navy receiver and coral double chevrons, no hands/body fragments or added loose props. Rear-side small lever detail differs from the source but remains coherent gun geometry. Broad painterly colour blocks remain; fine brush detail is smoother than reference. Uniform 0.70 m length, +Y up/+Z muzzle, actual wood pistol-grip centre at origin with separate support/buttplate/muzzle datums. No equipping, carrying/seating test, posing, rigging or animation.
visual_review.method: Actual decoded triangle/UV/base-colour geometry rendered with CPU depth buffer; measured socket overlay inspected.

import_review.notes: Real scene vertices and indices decoded; finite positions/UVs; retained embedded 1024px base colour. Uniform root transform; raw file preserved.
import_review.pivot_notes: Actual inspected feature bounds measured from triangle surface samples; only outer-root translation changed. No body poses/equipment/rigging.
